QuestInfo.name: Wonny's Dilemma
QuestInfo.0: You stand there with a blank look on your face, surprised at #p2152016#'s behavior, but another Black Wing watchman, #p2152018#, begins to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2152018##k says he will deliver the clothes to #p2154004#. You aren't 100% sure that the clothes will get delivered safely, but you don't really have a choice...
QuestInfo.2: You worried that #p2152018# would do the same thing as #p2152016#, but the sincere look on #p2152018#'s face convinced you. However, he still seemed to have a dilemma...

0.0: #p2152016# mentioned this. This is #t4032757#, right? #bHand it over and I'll deliver it.#k Can't guarantee they'll let me in that far since I'm not a high-ranked member yet, but better than nothing, right?

yes.0: I'm the liaison between Edelstein and the Black Wings Headquarters, so I ought to be able to get the cloak delivered.

no.0: I don't blame you for not trusting me. But there's no other way.

1.0: #t4032757#... I haven't seen this in a long time. Yes, I remember her wearing this when we took that picture in front of the Clocktower...

yes.0: I got the cloak. I'll do my best to deliver it. But don't hold your breath...

item.0: Have you lost #t4032757#? There's probably no way to recover it...
